dataset_provenance.scope: Assembled-context study-guide performance workload derived from MMLU-Pro material. This is not the MMLU-Pro test task, accuracy score, or official leaderboard protocol. The separate ten quality probes are synthetic arithmetic/extraction/format smoke tests.

original_prompt_protocol.test_selection: Sort test by (category, numeric question_id), take the first row of each of the 14 categories, selected before generation. Independently rechecked against the local parquet.
original_prompt_protocol.validation_examples: All five same-category validation rows in stored parquet order, with their reference CoT answers; this contributes 70 demonstrations across the 14 source prompts.
original_prompt_protocol.formatting: Remove N/A options, label remaining options A-J, use the pinned initial_prompt.txt with category substituted; demonstrations replace the A: Let's think step by step prefix with Answer: Let's think step by step; append the current test question without its answer.

assembly.source_chat: Decode the original Qwen3.8-27B token IDs including special tokens, remove only the checked outer single-user/assistant chat wrapper, assert the old chat template exactly round trips all source token IDs.
assembly.source_order: 14 selected prompts ordered by category, cyclically repeated. For case index 0..3, section i uses source[(i+index) % 14].
assembly.instruction: Use the following reference material to write a detailed study guide. <reference> ... </reference> Write a long study guide with explanations and worked examples for the topics above. Begin directly and keep writing until the token budget is exhausted.
assembly.template: Qwen3.5, single user message, tokenize=True, return_dict=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False.
assembly.truncation: Keep the first L-256 tokens and final 256 tokens of the rendered assembled prompt; discard the middle. Long scenario L=32768.
assembly.output_protocol: Greedy temperature 0, seed 17, fixed 8192 output tokens with ignore_eos=True, batch size 4. Not a natural-EOS task score.
assembly.identity_evidence: Final performance token IDs match corresponding task IDs in diffspec-qwen35-retest-20261029/inputs.json exactly. Copied into a local hash contract so runtime never reads prior report paths.
assembly.user_message_template:
Use the following reference material to write a detailed study guide.
<reference>
{sections}
</reference>
Write a long study guide with explanations and worked examples for the topics above. Begin directly and keep writing until the token budget is exhausted.

rows.p99_semantics: Request quantiles use 12 samples for three B4 starts. Engine output intervals use exact emitted-batch intervals; a speculative batch can contain multiple tokens.
